annotations.title: Explain a cron expression and list its next run times in any time zone

description: Explain a cron expression and list its next run times in any time zone. Parses a 5-field cron expression (lists, ranges, steps, month/day names, @daily/@hourly/... macros, Vixie day-of-month OR day-of-week rule) and returns the next N run times (up to 50) in UTC and in the given IANA zone, DST-aware. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
name: cron_next
title: Explain a cron expression and list its next run times in any time zone
